# Gufran Pathan

> Gufran Pathan is a first-year PhD student and the Rupert Emerson Fellow in the Department of Government at Harvard University. Gufran's research covers ethnic conflict, ethnic voting and ethnic appeals in South Asia.

Research interests: ethnic politics, ethnic conflict, media campaigns, intergroup relations.

- [Homepage](https://gufranpathan.github.io/): bio, working papers and teaching
- [CV (PDF)](https://gufranpathan.github.io/files/cv.pdf)
- [Research](https://gufranpathan.github.io/#research): working papers
- [Teaching](https://gufranpathan.github.io/#teaching)
- [Contact](https://gufranpathan.github.io/#contact): gufranpathan@fas.harvard.edu
